name: Kunimi Saya
source:
[url=/c65162]Ryou's[/url] classmate and one of the top-ranking students in the school (in terms of grades). She is popular with boys and the teachers trust her a lot. Because she keeps her private life enveloped in a veil of mystery and rarely goes out with her friends, girls who are jealous of her have been circulating rumors of Saya participating in compensated dating.

[Spoiler]Saya is the biological child of the killer, and is the one spraying graffiti across the town. She dies in Akemi's route. [/Spoiler]
